distinct_intervening_definition: For the same reuse event (e at t_prev, then t_now): the count of DISTINCT layer-local experts observed in any selection at a position strictly between t_prev and t_now, excluding e itself. Conceptually different from token_reuse_gap (a position-interval count, not a distinct-expert count) and never conflated with it under the same name.
reuse_event_definition: For layer-local expert e selected at position t_prev and next selected at position t_now (t_now > t_prev, t_prev being e's immediately preceding occurrence in this layer): one reuse event, with token_reuse_gap = t_now - t_prev (always >= 1). e's first-ever occurrence in a layer has no t_prev and is a COLD / FIRST OBSERVATION, tracked separately, never assigned an infinite or fabricated gap.
temporal_unit_definition: One POSITION = one (token_index, selection) entry yielded, in order, by Trace.token_selections(layer, phase) for one layer; positions are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... in that yielded order (never by raw token_index). A selection is an unordered SET of concurrently selected experts: no artificial within-token ordering is ever constructed.
